comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f. The whole conversion is three literals: a multiplier of 2.125, an offset of 5 in linear mode, and 256 divided by 12 subtracted above 5 times 2.125 in jump-point mode. The chord always uses the jump-point conversion for its intervals whatever the four switches are set to; the switches only affect the four converted outputs.
